title: Stowaway — Ride along with anything in the sky
excerpt: Every plane and satellite overhead is a seat with nobody in it. Stow away on one — real flights over real terrain, real orbits above it.
content_html:
Pick any aircraft or satellite passing over your house right now, and go sit in its window seat.

The sky here is the real one outside — your location, your weather, this minute's light — with the aircraft and satellites that are genuinely overhead. Click one and the camera follows it; stow away and it takes a seat on board, over real terrain.

All of that is drawn in real time, which needs JavaScript and WebGL 2. Switching JavaScript on for this site should do it.

content_html_zh:
现在选择任何经过你家的飞机或卫星，然后坐在靠窗的座位上。

这里的天空是真实的外面的天空——你的位置、你的天气、这一分钟的光线——飞机和卫星都真实地在头顶上。 单击其中一个，摄像机就会跟随它；收起后，它就可以坐在船上，在真实的地形上。

所有这些都是实时绘制的，这需要 JavaScript 和 WebGL 2。 为该网站打开 JavaScript 应该可以做到。
